calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, sum(quantity) AS qty, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns, (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_before
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

SELECT p.sku, max(f.quantity) maxq, min(f.quantity) minq, sum(f.quantity) units, COALESCE(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) returned_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233,103670)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units DESC
